dct_title_s: Zip Code Districts - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains boundaries for Newton's zip codes. Note that one of those zip codes, for a property at the eastern edge of the city, just above Commonwealth Avenue, is 02435. This is a Brighton zip code. It occurs in Newton because the properties are in Newton but with an address on Undine Rd, which is in Brighton.

Purpose: This layer was created primarily for and is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property and address or location matching purposes. More advanced user applications may focus on public policy and planning and related purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
Supplemental information: Maintenance is as needed and by the GIS Administrator.
